findings.description: Direct inspection of all V85 views and poses shows the front shorts still expose most upper thigh in sit and crouch. The measured shorts coverage rose only from V84 15.37% to 16.16% seated and 26.67% to 27.80% crouched, while the overskirt covers only about 18.6% seated and 32.8% crouched. The hem-weight increase does not provide acceptable coverage.
Direct sit and crouch renders show pointed overlapping skirt panel corners and trim around the knees/calves; side panels still collapse into strongly corrugated folds and intersect the legs.
The left/right side views show repeated accordion-like ridges and an uneven projecting hem. Front/back views also retain irregular inner-layer reveal and a visibly prototype-like surface.

nextAction: Keep V85 rejected. Rework the shorts as leg-shaped front/back pattern panels with a connected crotch/gusset and pose-capable hem geometry, using the measured Siroino body sections instead of repeating another isolated thigh-weight increase. Preserve the existing coverage diagnostic; rebuild, simulate, export and render, then inspect new images. Shape-key transfer remains prototype-only pending smoothing and FBX/Unity import validation.
